messages:
Maya (AE): Heads up team  HarborPay sent a 95-question RFI + capability sheet. Ask: technical responses, security questionnaire, POC SOW, and a price range for Dedicated vs Private. Deadline COB Monday. Uploaded to: /shared/harborpay/rfi/harborpay_rfi_v3.xlsx. Can we divvy?

Ravi (SE): I
I'll take the capability matrix and the deep technical Qs. Quick check: are they looking for quantized runtime support and function calling? Those two rows usually need runtime/eng confirm.

Maya (AE): Yes, they explicitly asked about int8 quantization and structured function outputs. They also want a sample throughput table for 100/500/1000 QPS.

Elena (Security): I'll do the security questionnaire. Looks like 28 core items + PCI + BYOK/HSM clarifications. Flagging any items that require contractual language.

Noah (Sales Ops): I'll map a two-tier pricing sketch: 4-week POC Dedicated baseline and an optional Private evaluation week. Need Ravi's QPS table to size. Also include optional on-site audit fee.

Ravi (SE): Draft technical notes (paste): "- Quantized models (int8) are supported on Dedicated and Private with validated operator kernels; Hosted may provide select quantized builds per model.
- Function calling: supported on Hosted/Dedicated; Private requires runtime >=2.1 and config for control-plane egress.
- Throughput estimates attached as a small table in the matrix (embedding-heavy vs gen-heavy)."

Elena (Security): Sample security answers: "TLS1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest, SOC2 Type II in progress (we provide SOC2 report on request), role-based access controls for logs, optional log export to customer S3, support for BYOK with AWS KMS/Azure Key Vault and HSM appliances in Private."

Elena (Security): Two escalations: export control question and PCI attestation language. Sam (Legal) 
-- can you review when I flag them?

Sam (Legal): Yep. Also confirm whether HarbourPay (sic) needs contractual language about third-party model licenses. If so, we should provide a short caveat in the RFI submission.

Maya (AE): Typo: HarbourPay is HarborPay :-) Good catch Sam. For contractual caveats, we should say "subject to model vendor terms" and propose an optional legal review.

Noah (Sales Ops): POC SOW sketch: "Week 0: provisioning + VPC peering; Week 1-2: ingestion & perf baselines; Week 3: security checks + optional Private smoke; Week 4: report & handoff." I'll include pricing ranges per week in the pricing sheet.

Ravi (SE): On fallback behavior (they asked): "Smart routing will fail over to compatible model variants or alternate region; customers may pin model versions to avoid fallback. Detailed policy is configurable per route."

Elena (Security): Logging Q: "Who accesses logs?" Answer: "For Private, logs remain in customer environment. For Hosted/Dedicated, tenant-scoped logs are accessible to authorized ops/support staff with audit trails; customers may configure external log export."

Noah (Sales Ops): Attachments to populate: capability_matrix_harborpay.xlsx (Ravi), security_answers_harborpay.docx (Elena), poc_sow_harborpay.pdf (Noah), pricing_ranges_harborpay.csv (Noah). Upload folder?

Maya (AE): Use /shared/harborpay/rfi/submission_bundle/. I will compress and submit after sign-offs.

drive-bot: Snapshot created: https://drive.internal/s/harborpay/rfi/submission_bundle/ :white_check_mark:

Maya (AE): Timeline: Ravi by Fri 3pm PT for matrix, Elena Thur EOD for security draft, Noah Fri 12pm PT for pricing/POC. I'll consolidate Sat morning for an internal review.

Ravi (SE): I can push a first pass matrix by Fri 10am PT.

Elena (Security): Security draft by Thu EOD. Will inline legal flags.

Noah (Sales Ops): Pricing + POC draft by Fri 12pm PT.

Sam (Legal): I'll review flagged legal items Fri afternoon.

Maya (AE): Thanks all. If anything blocks, call out here and @Sam for legal. Quick ask: include a short SLA blurb for Dedicated burst behavior. Ravi?

Ravi (SE): SLA blurb: "Reserved Dedicated pools: 99.95% availability for committed capacity. Burst is best-effort subject to region capacity; automatic graceful fallback to compatible variants is available and configurable to meet availability goals."

Maya (AE): Perfect. Closing the loop  I'll post a final checklist in the folder once drafts are in.
